newsitem.title: USA: Continental Airlines seeks to reduce debt.
newsitem.headline: Continental Airlines seeks to reduce debt.

text.p: Continental Airlines will continue to pay down its debt and eliminate costs in fiscal 1997, the company's chief financial officer, Larry Kellner, said.
The company, which made the statements in its fourth-quarter earnings release, did not provide details as to how it would pay debt and eliminate costs.

In the fourth quarter of 1996 the company issued $250 million of 9.5 percent senior unsecured notes, bought certain of its outstanding common stock warrants for $50 million and obtained a $74.5 million credit facility, it said.
